summary: Reproduced and fix confirmed. With 34 uncached prompt tokens and none cached, chat.py --show_tps printed the generated count as the Context count at ea4ef8dcbb58 (Context 6, Generate 6) and at the fix parent 47d83f567ccc (Context 8, Generate 8). At the fix b2b0980972f0 the same script printed Context 34 and Generate 7. No exception is involved; this is a wrong displayed value.
what_ran: repro.py computes the prompt length with the repository's own prompt format and tokenizer, launches unmodified examples/chat.py in a pseudo-terminal (-basic -tps -mode chatml -maxr 12 -cs 2048) with unquantized Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct on GPU 1, sends one message and parses the printed Context/Generate line.
limits: One short first-turn reply per commit, so cached_tokens was 0; a later turn with a non-zero cache was not exercised. Only -basic console mode was run, although the ledger says the block is shared by both modes. Sampling was not seeded, so generated counts differ between commits. The prompt throughput figure itself was not checked. Attempts 001 and 002 did not reach the trigger (unsuitable model, then a driver bug).
